output: 800x600; WebP or JPEG as labeled per result
responseTime: Client-observed round trip, p50 of warm requests; includes network latency.
cpuTime: Per-invocation CPU time from Wrangler tail; median of warm requests.
note: Synthetic fixtures for currently supported paths. Adam7 PNG and non-grid HEIC/HEIF are unsupported. Cloudflare analytics may omit invocation samples; Wrangler tail is the CPU fallback. Null CPU means neither source captured a sample.

analytics.note: Temporary Worker names may appear as __unknown__; analytics rows are correlated to request timestamps. cpuTimeP99 and memoryUsageBytesP99 are sampled per invocation, not exact peaks.
